Be aware guys, specially girls 
This guy is setting traps, do not go on his profile picture it's fake and it's of a real person.
Yesterday I and my friend posted about a guy who was making ridiculous comments under my posts and we exposed him,and he again commented shit under my posts today.
Looks like linekdin have plenty of guys like him,it's not even been a full of 2-3 months and I am officially dealing with a predator again, however I have ignored so many between these months but this one needs to be highlighted.
All thanks to my brother KUSH BHATT 
For making me aware and helping me to get to the reality of this person and this profile,and now as a fellow linekdin creator it's my responsibility to make you guys aware as well.
This post is gonna be long,so make sure you read it whole,I am already so sorry for it guys,but it's necessary to give you guys full information, you all have the right to know.

So it's basically a fake, hijacked or rented account made specifically for stalking purposes.
There is plenty of accounts like these, people rather hack accounts or rent them,and all they do is repost others person's posts,they do not have anything of their own for posting 
That's why I wonder how this person has more than 12k followers.
There's a website called bulkoid where you can purchase linkedin followers to make your profile look credible.
They make trusted profiles by these tricks and sends connection request and engage in others posts ( I also got request from him but I ignored)
Based on careful review of this linekdin profile,there are several serious issues that this profile appears to be fake.

1. Education 1976-1999 :- 23 years bachelor degree 
No bachelor degree program takes 23 years to complete 

2.The word 'present' appears in two places on profile 
This person claiming to be working as a research assistant in Indian air force from aug 24 to the present 
While simultaneously studying avionics at st.andrews college since July 2024
(Strange thing :- this college doesn't even provide such education)See the attached screenshot 

3. Claims to be self employed at India air force 
Air force is a government defence organization 
A person can either be a regular serving personnel or a civilian in contact,no one can be 'self employed' inside Indian air force.

4. company logo mismatch 
The profile states Indian air force but the logo tagged next to it belongs to a private legal firm (R&V legal)

5. Mismatched skills 
The skill 'assistants' is listed for the research assistant position while "merger & acquisitions (M&A) a corporate finance &legal skill is listed under aviation,which has no logical connection to air force research.

And what's Idcrawl
When someone types a name into it,it collects all publically available images,data on the internet,he probably took the profile picture from there.
Scammers often use search engines like Idcrawl or Google images to search for real officers or other persons photos.
comment: Beyond spotting fake profiles, platforms and users need stronger verification signals—especially for roles tied to defence or sensitive fields, where impersonation can create real-world risks.
